Name: SculptDeformer
Description: Sculpt Deformer with control and mirror support

attrs.Help_string:
Overview:
  Sculpt Deformer with control, two locators (sculptor + stretch origin), and mirror support.

How To Use:
  Fill in the fields below then build.

Fields:
- SetGeo: comma-separated list of target geometry names.
- SetParent: parent node for the built rig. If left as 'new_locator', a placeholder locator is created.
- Mirror: False builds as-is. True builds both L_ and R_ sides (auto-prefixes L_ if needed). Right_Only builds only the R_ side mirrored from the guide.
- CtrlSize: size of the control curve (default 1).
- CtrlColor: color of the control curve.
- Scale: comma-separated XYZ scale for the sculpt deformer (default 10,1,10 for flattening).

Tips:
- When Mirror is True, R_ side SetGeo names are auto-derived by replacing L_ with R_.
- The sculptor locator drives the deformer position; the stretch origin sets the sculpt stretch origin.
- Template parent examples: Spine_End_Jnt, Head_Jnt, L_Wrist_Jnt.
